en.headline: Customs dismantles syndicate and seizes 32 million illicit cigarettes worth HK$140 million
en.dek: Five people aged 44 to 65 were arrested after operations targeting bases in Tsuen Wan and Yuen Long; the group is also suspected of laundering HK$9.3 million.
body: Hong Kong Customs has dismantled a suspected illicit cigarette smuggling and money-laundering syndicate, seizing about 32 million duty-not-paid cigarettes with an estimated market value of HK$140 million.

Five people — three men and two women aged between 44 and 65 — were arrested. They include the alleged mastermind, a director and an employee of a linked trading company, and two owners of a logistics company.

Officers intercepted seven containers shipped from South Korea between September and October last year that had been declared as carrying metals or electrical appliances but concealed large quantities of cigarettes. Further operations between January and March this year targeted bases in Tsuen Wan, described as the command centre and transit warehouse, and Yuen Long.

Customs said the syndicate is also suspected of laundering about HK$9.3 million in proceeds. The five arrested remain on bail pending further investigation, and officers have not ruled out additional arrests.

zh.headline: 海關搞破私煙集團檢獲3200萬支香煙市值1.4億元
zh.dek: 拘捕5名44至65歲人士，行動針對荃灣及元朗據點，集團亦涉嫌清洗930萬元犯罪得益。
body: 香港海關搞破一個懷疑私煙走私及洗黑錢集團，檢獲約3200萬支未完稅香煙，估計市值1.4億元。
被捕的5人包括3男2女，年齡介乎44至65歲，當中有涉嫌主腦、相關貿易公司董事及僱員，以及一間物流公司兩名東主。
海關去年9月至10月截查七個由南韓抵港、報稱載運金屬或電器的貨櫃，發現藏有大量私煙。今年1月至3月進一步行動針對荃灣的指揮中心及中轉倉庫，以及元朗據點。
海關指集團亦涉嫌清洗約930萬元犯罪得益。5名被捕人士現正保釋候查，不排除再有人被捕。
